Clipboard and text

First click the text field inside the mirrored Android screen. The primary button reads the PC clipboard. If browser permission is blocked, paste text into the box below.

Automatic sync mirrors clipboard content only; it never pastes into the focused Android field.

With the Android screen focused, Ctrl+V pastes and Ctrl+C copies the Android selection. Clipboard text is never written to diagnostics.
